newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip in Peru oil deal with Phillips.
newsitem.headline: Agip in Peru oil deal with Phillips.

text.p: Italian Agip Spa's Agip Exploration BV on Friday signed an accord with Phillips Petroleum Peru Ltd, a unit of Phillips Petroleum Co, for the exploration of an oilfield in Peru, Agip's parent ENI said.
This will be the first time Agip has operated in Peru.
ENI said in a statement the accord concerned exploration in Block 82, a 12,254 square km area in southeast Peru for which Phillips signed a contract on Thursday with state-run Perupetro.
Phillips will transfer 50 percent of its activity to Agip, remaining the operator with the other 50 percent. The accord is currently being ratified by the Peru government, ENI said.
The concession includes a seven-year exploratory period to be followed by an eventual production phase lasting 30 years for oil and 40 years for gas.
Agip now operates in 26 countries. It began working in Latin America in 1968 in Colombia.
